authority: Architect planning coverage; 11 product areas partition the manifest and simulation-edge is a cross-cutting enabler; only Claims and Work pilot panels have node-level readiness gates

areas.question: What Action, distinct work case or attested record exists, and what later evidence verifies an intervention?
areas.fixture_gate: Action, attested work records and a separately accepted later verification window with actor/Site/Asset lineage.
areas.owner_choice: Decide Incident and Maintenance breadth or Drop separately from bounded S6 Action/verification.

areas.question: Which source records were accepted, how fresh and complete are they, and what exact lineage supports a claim?
areas.fixture_gate: Accepted, rejected, duplicate, delayed and missing source envelopes through normal ingestion; source freshness and capability gaps stay distinct.
areas.owner_choice: Keep S2 bounded Site/Lab evidence; choose broader evidence analysis after source health and cross-domain consumers are specified.

areas.question: Which Finding episode and revision does a screen show, with what evidence and limits?
areas.fixture_gate: Multi-revision Finding episode, recurrence, missing/late evidence and exact accepted-record lineage.
areas.owner_choice: Bounded S4 detail versus later Site/global lists and contextual tabs.

areas.question: What technical quantity, assumption revision and bounded amount can be claimed?
areas.fixture_gate: One versioned price change for S4; later aligned currency/period/coverage fixtures and explicit scenario basis for global money.
areas.owner_choice: S4 bounded consequence is queued; global rollup and what-if scenarios need separate tier decisions.

areas.question: Which service, renewable, fuel, backup and battery claims follow from accepted mini-grid evidence?
areas.fixture_gate: Separate complete, missing and contradictory windows for dispatch, service, renewable opportunity, fuel balance and backup; attested deliveries or requests where required.
areas.owner_choice: S3 dispatch and S7 first stress claim are queued; choose breadth by supported operational question.

areas.question: What Site, source, role and topology configuration was effective at the selected time?
areas.fixture_gate: Persisted Foundation and bindings at two effective times; unbound roles and absent thresholds remain visible rather than invented.
areas.owner_choice: S1 mini-grid configuration is queued; other domain role sets follow their domain decisions.

areas.question: Who can create, import or change a Site, policy or tenant setting, and what is the audited result?
areas.fixture_gate: Successful and refused Site drafts/import rows, template provenance, actor audit and tenant authorization; no partial published Site.
areas.owner_choice: Choose onboarding form, template, batch and Settings controls separately from S1's one-shot Kobo import.

areas.question: Which registered Asset, health, usage and warranty facts are supported by Site records?
areas.fixture_gate: One source-backed battery stress state plus distinct registration, service and warranty records with effective/recorded time and actor provenance.
areas.owner_choice: S7 first health state is queued; full Asset root, registration and warranty economics need their own tier.

areas.question: Which cross-Site comparison is valid under tenant, window, coverage, currency and overlap rules?
areas.fixture_gate: Multiple Sites with aligned windows, coverage, currency/price basis and consequence overlap groups, reloaded through normal ingestion.
areas.owner_choice: Decide core ranked Findings and value cards before building Portfolio; unlike bases remain separate.

areas.question: Did a temperature excursion or cooling/backup failure occur, and what work or consequence follows?
areas.fixture_gate: Cold-chain Foundation/roles, a new simulated world and captured physical-adapter peer, excursion and backup disturbance, missing sensor, multi-Site windows, actor-attested work and accepted lineage.
areas.owner_choice: Choose the cold-chain Site journey and incident/work depth after shared projections are specified for this consumer.

areas.question: What charging session, connector availability, energy and power-limit claim can be supported?
areas.fixture_gate: EV Foundation/roles, a new simulated world and captured physical-adapter peer, session and connector records, interrupted and missing-session variants, multi-Site windows and accepted lineage; no invented revenue.
areas.owner_choice: Choose the EV Site journey only after session/availability rules and a domain fixture are reviewed.

areas.status: architecture and queue gates; panel mapping stays with consuming product areas
areas.question: Can the Lab and captured physical reports use one registered gateway boundary, durable delivery and centrally visible diagnostics?
areas.fixture_gate: S2 demo uses registered Kobo Lab basis and simulated reports only, with restart-safe gateway and central diagnostic reload. The first real pilot adds one physical protocol capture or labelled vendor-format wire fixture; S7 battery stress remains Unknown until causally modelled or a real capture exists. Later domains add their own worlds and physical peers.
areas.owner_choice: No separate screen tier: this area supplies technical and data gates to product areas; scope follows the queued Site path and approved domain waves.
